text:
Mukteshwar is a village and tourist destination in the Nainital district of Uttarakhand, India.  It sits high in the Kumaon Hills at an altitude of 2171 meters (7500 feet), 51 km from Nainital, 72 km from Haldwani, and 343 km from Delhi.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Nainital in Uttarakhand is one of the most popular hill stations of India. It is famous for its lake, after which it is named. The town has a population of 41,400 (2011 est.)
best_time: March to June (pleasant summer flowers) and September to November (crisp autumn views)
